name: local-llm-mcp
description: Unified local and cloud LLM control plane: Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, HuggingFace, GPU management, plus an OpenAI-compatible gateway to 28 cloud providers.
long_description: Local LLM MCP is a production-grade FastMCP 3.4+ server that manages local inference engines (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp) and routes to 28 cloud providers through a Lightport-compatible AI gateway. It ships 13 portmanteau tools covering model lifecycle, generation, multimodal inference, GPU supervision, engine process control, provider health with circuit breakers, and an LLM help catalog. A React/Vite dashboard (ports 10832/10833) provides KPIs, provider health with LM Link peer discovery over Tailscale, chat with personalities, GPU telemetry, and fleet discovery.

tools.name: llm_health
tools.description: System and provider health, metrics, logging, tool catalog, graceful shutdown (11 operations).
